caption:
There are five things you can't take the SAT without.

Charged device with Bluebook and exam setup done, admission ticket, physical photo ID, pencils or pens, and your College Board username and password. Check them 5 days before the Nov 7 SAT.

Save this for test week.

youtube.description: Five days before the November 7, 2026 SAT, check the five required items so you still have time to fix anything missing.
